Haydock, H. (Ricardo-AEA) and Napp, T. (Imperial College) (2013). Decarbonisation of heat in industry: A review of the research evidence. Report for the Department of Energy and Climate Change, Ricardo-AEA/R/ED58571, Issue 1, 31 July 2013. Customer reference 531/11/2012. Ricardo-AEA, Harwell. Published by DECC as file D13 951813 ('Industrial Decarbonisation Literature Review'). 119 pp.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 10). A UK rapid evidence assessment: nearly every number is reprinted from other works (AEA 2010, Vallack et al. 2011 / Centre for Low Carbon Futures, Tam et al. IEA 2009, IEA ETP 2008, Carbon Trust IEEA sector guides, Scalet et al. glass BREF, ECRA/CSI, Fennell et al. 2012, Gartner); each note names the origin. Main file (29 technologies in 37 process contexts, 103 rows): sector summary Tables 2-10 and text for refinery/chemical/cement CCS abatement costs, SMR efficiency, steel long-term options (TGR-BF, HIsarna with and without CCS, Fastmelt, MIDREX-EAF reductions), inert-anode cells (USD 1-2 million per cell), paper-waste and brick syngas gasifiers (GBP 10-15 M for 5 MW; GBP 2 M per MW thermal input), microwave dryer (GBP 500k for 240 kW), gas-engine CHP GBP 800-900/kWe installed, cement BAT 3.1 GJ/t clinker, clinker substitution and sulpho-aluminate and MgO cements, fluidised-bed kiln, cement CCS, glass furnace status rows and submerged combustion; Appendix 11 CHP electrical efficiencies by size (GCV = HHV); IEA ETP 2008 biomass CHP and heat-boiler capex. _measures.csv: 40 quantified efficiency/switching measures with savings, costs and paybacks (refinery heat integration, paper drying, food processing, kiln fuel switching, brick heat recovery, glass cullet/preheating/oxy-fuel/WHR). _other-values.csv: relative capex/opex of steel options, UK rollout totals, sector shares, biomass power and co-firing costs, CCC electrification/hydrogen abatement cost. Not loaded: barrier/policy review (Sections 3.3-3.4), sector totals, CHP capacity projection (Figure 6, chart only). Bataille 2017 cites this report for ecocement, C-Fix and cementitious substitution, biomass in kilns, glass oxy-fuel and direct electric melting, smelt reduction and enzymatic catalysis: ecocement and C-Fix do not appear in this report (no match for either term), so Bataille's cost link for those rows is not supported here; the others are covered only qualitatively or as relative/abatement costs.

(1) Most costs have no price year (loaded with publication year 2013 and flagged); some carry a stated year (GBP2011, USD2011, USD2009, GBP2010, 2008 prices). (2) Fastmelt with CCS: 55% in text (p.20) vs 80% in Table 4 (p.23). (3) Biocatalysts: Table 3 USD 1-5/tCO2 vs text USD 15k-5k/tCO2 (2008 prices). (4) MgO cement capex GBP 220,000 for a 0.5-1 Mt clinker plant is implausibly low. (5) TGR-BF UK capex: text GBP 2.5 bn, table GBP 1.5-2.5 bn; table prints 'GBP20111.5' (year run into value). (6) Footer reference on the appendix pages reads 'Ricardo-AEA/ED58571' (missing /R/). (7) CCC electrification/hydrogen annualised costs printed as '0.2-0.36 GBP/yr' etc. with incomplete units. (8) Many abatement costs lack discount rate and baseline (the report itself says so, p.v).
